content:
The [Length Converter](/length-converter) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Convert length between metric and imperial units — metres, feet, miles and more. Enter your value and from unit and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

A length converter turns a measurement in one unit into every other common unit at once — metric and imperial side by side, from micrometres to nautical miles. It is the tool for converting heights, distances, fabric, room dimensions and road trips without working through the factors by hand. Every equivalent is shown together, so you can read off the one you need and compare units at a glance. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Length Converter

Start by entering your value, then choosing your from unit from the list. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause.

1. Enter the length you want to convert.
2. Choose the unit it is currently in — metres, feet, inches, miles and more.
3. Read the equivalent in every other unit. The result updates as you type.
4. Use Reset to return to the example values.

## Formula

Convert the input to metres first, then divide by the target unit's size in metres. 1 inch = 2.54 cm exactly, 1 foot = 0.3048 m, 1 yard = 0.9144 m, 1 mile = 1,609.344 m and 1 nautical mile = 1,852 m.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Length Converter](/length-converter) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. 1 metre = 100 cm = 39.37007874 inches = 3.2808399 feet = 1.0936133 yards = 0.0006213712 miles. A marathon (42.195 km) is 26.2188 miles. Try the same figures in the [Length Converter](/length-converter) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Value: 1, From unit: Metres (m)), the [Length Converter](/length-converter) returns Micrometres (µm): 1,000,000 µm, Millimetres (mm): 1,000 mm, Centimetres (cm): 100 cm, Metres (m): 1 m, Kilometres (km): 0.001 km, Inches (in): 39.37007874 in, Feet (ft): 3.2808399 ft, Yards (yd): 1.0936133 yd, Miles (mi): 0.00062137 mi, Nautical miles (nmi): 0.00053996 nmi. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Temperature Converter](/temperature-converter) is worth a look before you finish.

## Metric vs imperial

The metric system is decimal: 10 millimetres make a centimetre, 100 centimetres make a metre and 1,000 metres make a kilometre. The imperial system is not: 12 inches make a foot, 3 feet make a yard and 1,760 yards make a mile. That is why converting between the systems needs a calculator — the factors are awkward (an inch is exactly 2.54 cm by international agreement, and a foot is exactly 0.3048 m).

## Everyday conversions to remember

A few equivalents cover most daily needs: 1 inch ≈ 2.54 cm, 1 foot ≈ 30.48 cm, 1 metre ≈ 3.28 feet, 1 kilometre ≈ 0.62 miles, and 1 mile ≈ 1.61 km. For height, 5 feet 10 inches is 177.8 cm. For running, a 5K is 3.11 miles and a 10K is 6.21 miles.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- 1 inch is exactly 2.54 cm by definition — every other imperial conversion follows from it.
- For heights, convert to total inches first, then divide by 12 for feet and inches.
- A nautical mile (1,852 m) is used at sea and in the air; a land mile is 1,609.344 m.

## Frequently asked questions

### How many centimetres are in a foot?

Exactly 30.48 cm. A foot is defined as 0.3048 metres, so 12 inches × 2.54 cm = 30.48 cm. Try it with your own numbers in the [Length Converter](/length-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### How many kilometres are in a mile?

1.609344 km. A quick estimate is to multiply miles by 1.6, or divide kilometres by 1.6 to get miles. Try it with your own numbers in the [Length Converter](/length-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What is a nautical mile?

1,852 metres — one minute of latitude. It is used in navigation because it relates directly to the Earth's geometry, unlike the land mile. Try it with your own numbers in the [Length Converter](/length-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What formula does the Length Converter use?

Convert the input to metres first, then divide by the target unit's size in metres. 1 inch = 2.54 cm exactly, 1 foot = 0.3048 m, 1 yard = 0.9144 m, 1 mile = 1,609.344 m and 1 nautical mile = 1,852 m. You can see it in action in the [Length Converter](/length-converter) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

Just Value and From unit. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.
